data.name: Veil: Project Conductor
data.detailed_description:
The train derails in an abandoned tunnel.
No signal, no exits — only darkness and the broken remains of the carriage.
You are an undercover journalist, and you had a reason to be on this train.

Veil: Project Conductor is a story-driven psychological horror visual novel. One night trapped in an underground railway hub, a network of forgotten stations and service tunnels, a handful of survivors — and a mystery far more terrifying than the crash itself.

Every choice pulls you deeper into Project CONDUCTOR.
Every hesitation increases the chance that someone may never reach the surface.

WHAT AWAITS YOU

• A motivated protagonist — and you act through his perspective
The story unfolds through the eyes of a journalist pursuing his own truth.

• A psychological, tension-filled detective narrative
Dark tunnels, survivors, hidden links between passengers — and a constant feeling that something is terribly wrong.

• Mystery and pressure you unravel alongside the protagonist
Reconstruct events and discover the true cause of the disaster.

• Two main endings
Your decisions determine which outcome becomes the finale of your story.

• QTE mechanics, item search and turn-based fighting
The game includes quick-reaction events, object-finding episodes and elements of turn-based combat.

• Exploration and evidence gathering
Search the tunnels, uncover documents and clues, and piece together the full picture of what happened.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 / 8 / 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel / AMD 1.8 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any GPU with DirectX 9 support (Intel HD Graphics 3000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel / AMD 2.4+ GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU with DirectX 11 support (Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any

content_descriptors.notes: A combat scene with a creature is included, and both the protagonist and other characters may die depending on the story path (this is not mandatory). The consequences of these events will be shown. Blood and a deceased body may appear on screen. Both of these outcomes depend on the player’s actions and occur only in specific scenes of the game.
